name: Tailark
description: A registry scoped to marketing pages: hero sections, pricing, testimonials, illustrations, all built on shadcn/ui, Next.js and Radix or Base UI underneath. Lists teams at Figma and Promptwatch among its users, so the blocks read as opinionated rather than generic.
